items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Chappy Willard was our show business arranger.

ctx.x: Chappy Willard was our show business arranger. His music was flair. He had big introductions and some semi-classical thing like Holiday For Strings was a big deal. He wrote us an arrangement of Holiday For Strings that just tore the house down.
Did he do those arrangements for, what was the name, Avas Andrews.
